title: RACING LOUNGE! Copi Cafe Episode 60 | Cornucopias
description:
Join Cornucopias Co-CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones in Episode 60 of Copi Cafe as they react to Crypto Crow's exclusive early access to parts of their highly anticipated upcoming game! They'll also be covering OG testing and discussing the latest poll results.

This episode is packed with Information as they answer highly awaited community questions and give a sneak peek into the upcoming Crypto conferences they're attending.

And as always, stay tuned for a Copi Cafe highlight—the guys are revealing another exciting RACING LOUNGE LEAK!

Don't miss out!

Crypto Crow: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwsRWmIL5XKqFtdytBfeX0g

00:00 Beverage Choices
03:29 Crypto Crow
09:40 OG Testing
24:02 Community Questions
26:29 Conferences
27:40 Leak!

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items. 

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/cornucopiasgame
